objective: Measure how different LLMs perform on different software-engineering task types and RAG tasks. The primary comparison must be category-wise, not a single overall score.

Explanation.interpretation: Measures whether the model accurately explains the requested code behavior without introducing unsupported claims.

Code Retrieval.scoring_method: Compare identified files, functions, symbols, URLs, or execution order with the expected answer.
Code Retrieval.interpretation: Measures the model's ability to locate and identify relevant code elements in the codebase.

Dependency Understanding.scoring_method: Score whether the model correctly identifies components and relationships in the execution or data dependency graph.
Dependency Understanding.interpretation: Measures understanding of how modules, services, files, APIs, and data artifacts depend on one another.

Bug Analysis.scoring_method: Score identification of the actual bug, root cause, likely effect, and technically appropriate fix.
Bug Analysis.interpretation: Measures the model's ability to reason about faults in the existing code and configuration.

Code Generation.scoring_method: Execute generated code against predefined isolated tests. Do not modify or execute directly against the production Week 3 files.
Code Generation.interpretation: Measures whether generated code satisfies the requested behavior and passes automated tests.

Refactoring.scoring_method: Execute refactored code against predefined tests and compare required behavior with the original implementation.
Refactoring.interpretation: Measures whether the model can restructure code without breaking required behavior.

RAG based Question.scoring_method: Evaluate retrieved evidence against gold handbook sources and evaluate the final answer against expected handbook facts.
RAG based Question.interpretation: Measures retrieval quality and the model's ability to produce grounded answers from the Aadhaar Handbook.

response_latency.description: Wall-clock time required to obtain the model response.

output_tokens.description: Number of generated output tokens when available.

total_tokens.description: Total prompt plus generated tokens when available.

resource_consumption.description: Resource consumption recorded during evaluation when available.

retrieval_quality.description: Measures whether retrieved chunks contain evidence that directly supports the expected answer.
retrieval_quality.not_definition: Lexical similarity alone must not be treated as evidence of retrieval success.

grounded_answer_correctness.description: Measures coverage of expected facts while penalizing unsupported or contradictory claims.

hallucination_rate.description: Percentage of evaluated responses containing factual claims unsupported by the retrieved context or gold handbook evidence.

abstention_quality.description: For out-of-knowledge-base questions, rewards explicit acknowledgement that the handbook does not establish the requested information.

behavior_preservation.description: Refactored code must preserve the behavior required by the original implementation and evaluation specification.

comparison_rules: Every model must receive exactly the same 35 evaluation tasks.
The seven categories must be reported separately.
Do not use a single overall accuracy as the primary conclusion.
For each category, identify the strongest model using that category's primary metric.
Secondary metrics must be reported alongside the primary metric.
Latency and token usage must be reported so quality can be considered together with efficiency.
Code Generation and Refactoring must use automated tests rather than subjective scoring alone.
RAG retrieval quality must be evaluated against supporting evidence rather than lexical similarity alone.
Out-of-knowledge-base RAG tasks should reward appropriate abstention.
The evaluation must preserve the same task wording across all models.

expected_category_output.required_conclusion: State which model performs best for the category and explain the result using the measured metrics.
